intro i
rw [disjointed_def]
simp only [disjointed_def, partialSups_def, supr_eq_supr_of_locally_finite_order_bot]
apply le_antisymm
· rw [le_supr]
  exact (le_supr f i).trans (le_supr f (i + 1))
· rw [supr_le]
  intros j hj
  rcases hj with ⟨k, hk⟩
  rcases hk with ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have : k < i + 1 := h1
  rw [lt_add_iff_add_right] at this
  exact (le_of_lt this).trans h2
